snippet.title: Nullstar Solus | Frosty Games Fest 2025
snippet.description:
Featured in Frosty Games Fest 2025! Watch the full showcase here: https://youtu.be/3ff3YxX7Cgw

Wreck. Refine. Perfect. This new trailer for Nullstar: Solus showcases never-before-seen levels, a new UI and new music. Get ready to fight for leaderboard superiority in this precision platformer where speed is of the essence, as your drone races down into forgotten, overgrown chambers and corridors, facing ancient dangers and forgotten hazards in its quest for the most powerful energy source in existence.

Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3094210/Nullstar_Solus/

Find more games made in Australia and Aotearoa New Zealand on our Steam event page here: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/45423962/sale/FrostyGamesCelebration
